description: Files engine reading one JSON document: a dbt manifest. Databases and schemas collected from models, seeds, snapshots and sources (tests left out), dataset types from the materialization (ephemeral as a view, seeds and sources as tables), source tables named by their identifier, column docs from models and sources, model dependencies as lineage through forEach over a templated where list, simple and derived metrics, and semantic-model entities as business terms with duplicates collected.
